tiers.name: pilot
tiers.purpose: population invariance (E0, E00, RS against baseline), the phase response at pi/2 and pi, inverse INV2 against E00, R2 against A2; gate before the main jobs

tiers.name: main
tiers.purpose: every arm: the phi scan (P1-P7, E0), inverse, composition and alternation (held out), the three equivalent dephasings (A2, R2, R4) and the feed-forward sham

tiers.name: controls
tiers.purpose: direct q75 population benchmark (e0, e2, e4, R2, A2 from |0>, |1>, 8 repetitions, TOST +-0.02 against e0) and the Knee classical-disturbance circuits (|0>, |1>, |+>, |+i> x e4, e2, A2, sham; 1000 shots)

options.name: incommensurate phase (1 rad)
options.tests: no finite permutation group contains Rz(1 rad) exactly; INV(1, -1) = identity forces e(1) to be a permutation (#32's Lemma), whose powers repeat with a period the quantum response does not have

options.name: finer scan (16 points)
options.phases: e(k pi / 8) for odd k (8 arms), INV and COMP at pi / 8
options.tests: a Z_8 register cannot represent pi / 8; a Z_16 one can (d >= 16 n_pop): raises D, no absolute exclusion

options.name: irrational scan (golden angle)
options.phases: e(j phi_g), j = 1..8, phi_g = 2.39996 rad; INV and COMP at phi_g
options.tests: phases outside any small cyclic group; a register needs n large enough to approximate all of them at the plan's resolution

options.name: dimension witness on the existing scan
options.phases: none: the rank of the cross-arm Hankel matrix of the 8 scan points
options.tests: a lower bound on the hidden dimension any model needs; weak (a d = 16 register has room)

options.name: second incommensurate angle (7 arms, not simulated)
